svg.title: What an update touches, and what it leaves alone
svg.desc: The EnvProxy folder has three areas with different rules. The top level is yours: an update only overwrites files with the same name and never deletes anything of yours. win, mac, release-notes and assets belong to the program: an update overwrites them and removes files the new package no longer has, so do not put your own files there. Inside win\monitor\ and mac\monitor\ sit the log and the run markers, which are never overwritten and never deleted. Three more things it never touches: the system proxy, system-wide environment variables, and admin rights or system folders.
